```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

## Bitcoin Daily Price

```{r}
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw))

bitcoin <- prices |>
  filter(
    coin_id == "btc",
    date >= as.Date("2018-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
  )

ggplot(bitcoin, aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Crypto Market Share by Category

```{r}
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories, by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      category_id == "bitcoin" ~ "Payment",
      category_id == "smart-contract-platform" ~ "Smart Contract Platform",
      category_id == "stablecoin" ~ "Stablecoin",
      category_id == "defi" ~ "DeFi",
      category_id == "exchange-token" ~ "Exchange",
      category_id == "meme-coin" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

The provided metadata uses **Bitcoin**, **Exchange Token**, and **Meme Coin** for three
groups; these are displayed as **Payment**, **Exchange**, and **Other** here to match
the requested chart labels.

```{r}
market_share <- crypto |>
  filter(date <= as.Date("2025-12-31")) |>
  group_by(date, category) |>
  summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(share = market_cap_usd / sum(market_cap_usd)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "Payment",
        "Smart Contract Platform",
        "Stablecoin",
        "DeFi",
        "Exchange",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(crypto) == nrow(prices),
  !anyNA(crypto$category),
  all(abs(market_share |> summarise(total = sum(share), .by = date) |> pull(total) - 1) < 1e-8)
)

ggplot(market_share, aes(x = date, y = share, fill = category)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(
      xmin = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      xmax = as.Date(c("2022-05-13", "2022-11-12")),
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = tibble(
      date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-10")),
      label = c("Luna / UST crash", "FTX collapse")
    ),
    aes(x = date, y = 1.04, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1.09),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Share of the combined market capitalization of the covered coins, 2018–2025",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of market capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: provided daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet datasets."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
